name: Formsort Free
free_limit: Hosted low-code form builder Free plan: 100 flow starts per month per workspace, unlimited users and forms, custom logo and colors, and Formsort branding. A flow start is counted when a respondent completes at least one step or restarts with new answers; non-production environment starts are excluded.
watch_out: Free is intended for experimenting with initial forms. At the 100-flow-start monthly cap, additional responses are discarded rather than retained. Formsort branding is required; advanced design, returning responders and higher volumes require Pro. The provider explicitly specifies credit-card payments for Pro but does not clearly state whether Free signup requires a card. Its terms address business customers but do not explicitly confirm unrestricted commercial use of Free; verify before production use. Paid Pro overages can incur charges; do not assume Free has paid overages.
